-- script --
start /home/evan
size 60 10
note the ghost shows what Tab would add; the cursor sits on it
type pro
snapshot ghost
note right accepts it
press right
state filter projects/
note a chain: complete the next segment
type gl
snapshot chain
press tab
state filter projects/gloss
note two folders share gloss: now Tab steps through them
press tab
state filter projects/gloss/
press ctrl+u
type projects/glo
press tab tab tab
state filter projects/glossary/
press shift+tab
state filter projects/gloss/
note fuzzy completion when nothing starts with the letters
press ctrl+u
type rdm
press tab
state filter readme.md
note smart case: a capital in the typed name matches case
press ctrl+u
type z
press tab
state filter Zebra.txt
note nothing to complete
press ctrl+u
type qq
press tab
state filter qq
note tilde and parent
press ctrl+u
type ~/pho
press tab
state filter ~/photos/
press ctrl+u
type ../ev
press tab
state filter ../evan/
